text: Good evening, sorry ah to disturb you so late, I am the lola of a boy 6 years old. He got fever 39 degrees tonight. Then just now I see small small speckles on his legs and tummy, purple-red colour. I press the glass like my anak told me but the speckles don't go away leh, still can see through the glass. Diyos ko I'm so worried. Sorry to trouble you, can advise what to do? Salamat po
